record.question: Who is the Chairman of Planning Commission?
record.explanation: Answer B: Manmohan Singh. The Prime Minister chaired the Planning Commission. Its original annual reports identify Dr Manmohan Singh as Chairman and Montek Singh Ahluwalia as Deputy Chairman, so option B answers this March 2010 historical question. Historical/source note: Historical Planning Commission office in 2010; the institution was subsequently replaced by NITI Aayog. Reference: https://www.idsa.in/system/files/AnnualReport_PlanningCommission1011.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
